services: Professional engineering services pool / on-call framework including route studies, schematic design, minor bridge design, roadway design, traffic and signalization studies, and preparation of plans, specifications, and estimates.
relevance_explanation:
- Broad multi-discipline on-call services pool without a defined specific structure.
